name: ZCA_BI_CRM_CALENDAR
description: This table stores Gregorian and Accounting Calendar information.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE ID for Saas Enablement.

columns.name: REPORT_DATE
columns.description: Calendar Date.

columns.name: DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: Day Number of Week.

columns.name: CAL_WEEK_CODE
columns.description: Concatenation of Calendar Year and "Week" and Week Number.

columns.name: CAL_WEEK
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier of a week in a calendar year.

columns.name: CAL_WEEK_START_DATE
columns.description: The start date of the week.

columns.name: CAL_WEEK_END_DATE
columns.description: The end date of the week.

columns.name: PRIOR_SEQUENTIAL_WEEK
columns.description: Previous CAL_WEEK.

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR_WEEK
columns.description: Previous Years CAL_WEEK.

columns.name: CAL_MONTH
columns.description:
Unique numeric
identifier for the month in a calendar year.

columns.name: CAL_MONTH_CODE
columns.description: Concatenation of Calendar Year and Month Number.

columns.name: CAL_MONTH_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the calendar month.

columns.name: CAL_MONTH_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the calendar month.

columns.name: PRIOR_SEQUENTIAL_MONTH
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier of the month prior to CAL_MONTH.

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR_MONTH
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier of the same month in the previous year.

columns.name: CAL_QUARTER
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier of the quarter in a calendar year.

columns.name: CAL_QUARTER_CODE
columns.description: Concatenation of Year and 'Q' and Quarter number.

columns.name: CAL_QTR_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the calendar quarter

columns.name: CAL_QTR_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the calendar quarter

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR_QTR
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier of the quarter in the previous year.

columns.name: PRIOR_SEQUENTIAL_QTR
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier of the previous quarter.

columns.name: CAL_YEAR
columns.description: Calendar year.

columns.name: CAL_YEAR_NAME
columns.description: CAL_YEAR_NAME.

columns.name: CAL_YEAR_START_DATE
columns.description: The start date of the calendar year.

columns.name: CAL_YEAR_END_DATE
columns.description: The end date of the calendar year.

columns.name: PRIOR_YEAR
columns.description: Prior year.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_SET_ID
columns.description: defaulted to -1.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Calendar period adjustment status.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the accounting calendar.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting period type. Examples are Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: System generated accounting period name.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique period number within accounting calendar year.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_NUMBER
columns.description: Quarter number of accounting period.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_NUMBER
columns.description: Denotes the accounting calendar year represented by a numerical value, such as 2009.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the accounting period begins.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the accounting period ends.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the quarter containing this accounting period starts.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the quarter containing this accounting period ends.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the year containing this accounting period starts.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the year containing this accounting period ends.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_QUARTER
columns.description: It is a concatenation of Fiscal Year Number  and 'Q' and Fiscal Quarter Number.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_YEAR
columns.description: Enterprise year.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an Accounting Calendar.

columns.name: DAY_OF_MONTH
columns.description: DAY_OF_MONTH of the table FND_CAL_DAY.

columns.name: DAY_OF_YEAR
columns.description: DAY_OF_YEAR of the table FND_CAL_DAY.
